陈洛兮看见王野从屋里背出了一个背篓，就问：“王野，你背的什么呀？”

王野神秘一笑，说：“到了就知道了。”

陈洛兮“哼”了一声：“不说拉倒，好像谁稀罕一样。”

王野背着背篓，抱起王笑笑，叫了一声王江河，说：“走喽！出去玩喽！”

一行人浩浩荡荡的到了北海公园，王野带着众人来到小船租赁处，一问押金一块，租金一小时一毛。陈洛兮刚要掏钱，就被王野拦住了：“洛兮，还是我来吧！”

“是我叫你出来玩的，就应该我请客。”

王野故意一抬头，拍着胸口说：“一个大老爷们和美女出来玩儿，还要美女掏钱，那我的老脸往哪儿放啊！”

王野故意说的特别夸张，看着王野那夸张的样子，陈洛兮笑的花枝招展。

王野趁机把钱给了售票员，王野先上了小船，然后扶着王江河上了船。作为一个后世人，王野没有多想就伸手去扶陈洛兮，陈洛兮看到王野伸过来的手，顿时一愣，白皙的脸颊迅速泛起红晕，像是一朵盛开的桃花，从脸颊蔓延至耳根。

那一抹红在阳光下显得格外娇羞可爱。她抿着嘴唇，眼睛里闪过一丝羞怯与犹豫，但最终还是轻轻把手搭在了王野的手上。王野只感觉入手一片柔软温热，心跳也不自觉地漏了一拍。他稳稳地扶住陈洛兮，将她拉上了船。

陈洛兮上船后，小声说道：“谢谢。”声音轻得如同蚊呐，低着头不敢看王野。

王野挠挠头，笑着说：“不客气，坐稳咯，我们出发啦！”

说着便划动船桨，小船缓缓驶向湖中心。微风吹拂着陈洛兮的发丝，她偷偷抬眼看向王野，那脸上的红晕还未完全褪去，仿佛带着无尽的少女心事。

在王笑笑的欢笑中，陈洛兮也恢复了正常。到了湖中心，王野停止划动小船。陈洛兮疑惑的看着王野说：“你怎么不划了，累了吗？”

王野贱兮兮的说：“小姑凉，你怕不怕，大灰狼要来了。”

陈洛兮一下就笑喷了。

王野夸张的说道：“无聊，不和你玩儿了。”

说完王野自顾自的组装起了鱼竿。陈洛兮好奇宝宝一样看着王野忙活，当看到王野组装好鱼竿后，满脸惊讶：“王野，你要钓鱼呀？”

王野一脸严肃：“你看错了，我要钓大象！”

陈洛兮一愣气鼓鼓的“哼”了一声：“坏死你得了！”

王野手伸进背篓，从空间里取出一块儿羊肝儿，和短刀。用短刀把羊肝儿切成小块儿当成鱼饵。陈洛兮，王江河和王笑笑就看着王野在那儿忙活。当王野的鱼钩入水时，三个小脑袋也随着鱼钩转向水面。王笑笑在上船时就到了陈洛兮怀里了。

小丫头看了一会儿就没兴趣了，在陈洛兮怀里扭动了起来。陈洛兮感觉到了王笑笑的扭动，低头柔声的说：“笑笑要干什么呀？”

王笑笑抬头看着陈洛兮，奶声奶气的说：“姐姐抱~姐姐香。”

Chen Luoxi saw Wang Ye carrying a basket from the house and asked, "Wang Ye, what are you carrying?"

Wang Ye smiled mysteriously and said, "We'll know when we get there."

Chen Luoxi snorted: "If you don't talk about knocking me down, it seems like no one cares."

Wang Ye carried the basket on his back, picked up Wang Xiaoxiao, called Wang Jianghe, and said, "Let's go! Let's go out to play!"

The group of people arrived at Beihai Park in a mighty manner. Wang Ye took everyone to the boat rental office and asked about the deposit of one yuan and the rental fee of ten cents per hour.Just as Chen Luoxi was about to pay, Wang Ye stopped him: "Luoxi, I'll do it!"

"I asked you to come out to play, so I should treat you."

Wang Ye raised his head deliberately, patted his chest and said: "A big man goes out to play with a beautiful woman, and he still wants the beautiful woman to pay for it, so where can I put my old face!"

Wang Ye deliberately said it in an exaggerated way. Seeing Wang Ye's exaggerated look, Chen Luoxi smiled brightly.

Wang Ye took the opportunity to give the money to the conductor. Wang Ye got on the boat first, and then helped Wang Jianghe get on the boat.As a descendant, Wang Ye reached out to help Chen Luoxi without much thought. Chen Luoxi was stunned when she saw Wang Ye's extended hand, and a blush quickly appeared on her fair cheeks, like a blooming peach blossom, spreading from her cheeks to her ears.

That touch of red looks particularly shy and cute in the sun.She pursed her lips, a trace of shyness and hesitation flashed in her eyes, but in the end she gently put her hand on Wang Ye's hand.Wang Ye only felt soft and warm in his hands, and his heart skipped a beat unconsciously.He held Chen Luoxi firmly and pulled her onto the boat.

After Chen Luoxi got on the boat, she whispered: "Thank you." Her voice was as light as a mosquito, and she lowered her head and did not dare to look at Wang Ye.

Wang Ye scratched his head and said with a smile: "You're welcome, sit tight, let's go!"

As he spoke, he rowed the oars and the boat slowly sailed towards the center of the lake.The breeze blew Chen Luoxi's hair, and she secretly raised her eyes to look at Wang Ye. The blush on her face had not completely faded away, as if she was filled with endless girlish thoughts.

Amidst Wang Xiaoxiao's laughter, Chen Luoxi also returned to normal.At the center of the lake, Wang Ye stopped rowing the boat.Chen Luoxi looked at Wang Ye doubtfully and said, "Why don't you stop paddling? Are you tired?"

Wang Ye said coquettishly: "Sister-in-law Liang, are you afraid? The big bad wolf is coming."

Chen Luoxi burst into laughter immediately.

Wang Ye said exaggeratedly: "I'm bored, I won't play with you anymore."

After saying that, Wang Ye went about assembling the fishing rod.Chen Luoxi looked at Wang Ye's work like a curious child. When she saw Wang Ye assembling the fishing rod, she was full of surprise: "Wang Ye, do you want to fish?"

Wang Ye looked serious: "You are wrong, I want to catch elephants!"

Chen Luoxi was stunned and said angrily: "You deserve to die!"

Wang Ye reached into his backpack and took out a piece of mutton liver and a short knife from the space.Use a short knife to cut the liver into small pieces and use it as bait.Chen Luoxi, Wang Jianghe and Wang Xiaoxiao watched Wang Ye busy there.When Wang Ye's fishhook entered the water, the three little heads also turned to the water with the fishhook.Wang Xiaoxiao was in Chen Luoxi's arms when she boarded the boat.

The little girl lost interest after watching it for a while and began to squirm in Chen Luoxi's arms.Chen Luoxi felt Wang Xiaoxiao's twist, lowered her head and said softly: "What are you going to do with Xiaoxiao?"

Wang Xiaoxiao looked up at Chen Luoxi and said in a sweet voice, "Sister, hug me~Sister smells so good."
